title: PMVS Polymarket venue state profile v1
description: Machine shape for the Polymarket-specific custody, market, collateral, order, redemption, and settlement-freeze evidence used by the included backend.

custodyConfigs.$comment: IDs are unique and entries are sorted by custodyConfigId; the PMVS verifier enforces both rules.

positions.$comment: Entries are sorted by numeric positionId and then custodyConfigId. The PMVS verifier checks ID references, position/event equality, and set completeness.

books.$comment: Exactly one entry is required per distinct held assetId whose condition has payoutDenominator 0 and therefore uses the displayed-book cross path. A resolved condition uses its pinned CTF payout vector and has no book entry. The PMVS verifier checks numeric ordering, response references, payout-state agreement, and position correlation.

routeConfigs.$comment: routeId values are unique and sorted; the PMVS verifier checks position references.

standardOracleConfigs.$comment: Config IDs are unique and sorted. The PMVS verifier checks question references and event equality.

negRiskConfigs.$comment: Config IDs are unique and sorted. The PMVS verifier checks low-byte derivation, reference equality, event equality, and questionIndex < questionCount.

redemptionConfigs.$comment: Route IDs are unique and sorted. The PMVS verifier checks position references, call sequencing, entrypoint equality, sweep completeness, and final pUSD output.

redemptionExecutions.$comment: Execution IDs are unique. The PMVS verifier binds each executable valuation or zero-NAV recovery plan to one custody account, one condition, one redemption route, and exactly the held position IDs that the call plan consumes. A normal roll does not execute these calls inside its protected settlement transaction.

orderCommitments.$comment: This is the bounded set of current active, unfilled V2 orders disclosed to the record. It does not prove that no undisclosed signature exists. The PMVS verifier checks order hashes, references, normalized signature-result fields, effective remaining amounts, reservation equations, uniqueness, and exact pinned reads for signatureValid and other onchain results.

settlementFreezeConfigs.$comment: The PMVS verifier requires complete custody-and-route coverage and binds each predicate to exact reads. Version 1 permits only effective-user-pause in settlement scope; transfer-authorities-revoked is diagnostic because pUSD is upgradeable. Receipt and trace checks bind the protected call to the pre-anchor settlement call-plan hash and receipt-block runtime of a direct non-delegating enforcer. From the first pause read through completion, its call graph preserves every pause, makes no call into or from strategy custody, and makes no state-changing V2 call. Core funding sources are prefunded before capture and disjoint from strategy custody.

wrappedCollateralConfig.$comment: This value is non-null exactly when a negative-risk position is held; the PMVS verifier enforces the cross-array condition.

erc1155Approvals.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks candidate completeness, tuple ordering, and all-null versus all-present event provenance.

erc20Allowances.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks candidate completeness, tuple ordering, and all-null versus all-present event provenance.

authorities.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks tuple ordering and all-null versus all-present event provenance. In settlement scope, it also requires exact equality with an independently reconstructed expectedAuthorityIdentities set and an active wrapper role for the selected pUSD offramp.

responses.$comment: responseHash values are unique; the PMVS verifier checks book references.

$comment: JSON Schema closes the transport shape and fixed deployment discriminators. The PMVS verifier also enforces uint256 upper bounds, equality between arbitrary instance fields, unique IDs, reference resolution, ordering, set completeness, exposure equations, route/call correspondence, and bindings from normalized onchain values to unique exact target, calldata, return-data, and valuation-block reads in inputs.chainState.

uint256.$comment: uint256; the PMVS verifier enforces the exact upper bound.

positiveUint256.$comment: positive uint256; the PMVS verifier enforces the exact upper bound.

uint248.$comment: uint248; the PMVS verifier enforces the exact upper bound.

redemptionExecution.$comment: The PMVS verifier resolves every reference, binds the execution to one custody and condition, requires exact position-set coverage, and forbids any position from being consumed by more than one execution. The two payout numerators and denominator are exact CTF reads at the valuation block. Denominator 0 requires two zero numerators and selects the displayed-book cross mark. A positive denominator requires a valid payout vector, selects redemption valuation, and binds the exact call-plan output.

settlementFunctionSelector.$comment: Registry uses rollEpoch or rollEpochZeroNav; atomic mode uses the corresponding WithAnchor function. The outer verifier binds the selector to profiles.anchorMode.

settlementCallPlanHash.$comment: The domain-separated pre-anchor hash defined by venue/polymarket/1. It binds chain, enforcer, selector, epoch, attempt, branch, request-id hashes, roots, and totals. It excludes PMVSAnchorInput, record hash, URI, and signature.

settlementFreezeConfig.$comment: The enforcer must evaluate the exact predicate reads in the same transaction before it can settle. A point-in-time pause or allowance observation is not a freeze. The PMVS verifier binds coverage, exact read calldata, expected return values, selector, pre-anchor settlement call plan, source, and enforcer identity. Settlement scope accepts only effective-user-pause and requires a direct non-delegating enforcer with the recorded runtime hash. From the first pause read through completion, the protected transaction cannot call into or originate from strategy custody and cannot enter a state-changing V2 path.

orderCommitment.$comment: The signed Order has no expiry or cancellation nonce. This entry records one currently active, unfilled order disclosed to the record. The PMVS verifier recomputes its EIP-712 hash, checks normalized signature and custody fields, applies the V2 zero-remaining default, derives the reserved asset and amount, and binds signatureValid and order status to exact pinned exchange reads.

standardVenuePosition.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks condition, collection, and position derivations and equality to related venue fields.

negativeRiskVenuePosition.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks condition, collection, and position derivations and equality to related venue fields.

depositWalletCustodyConfig.$comment: makerAddress and orderSignerAddress equal custodyAccount. The authority set contains the active deposit-wallet-factory-upgrader proved by the pinned factory implementation. The PMVS verifier requires accountSignerAddress == owner == controllers[0], complete event-derived session candidates, timestamp-derived activity, resolver/proxyMode/pinning correspondence, and owner-path order signatures without the Deposit session-envelope magic suffix.

legacySafeCustodyConfig.$comment: makerAddress equals custodyAccount and orderSignerAddress equals accountSignerAddress. The PMVS verifier recomputes the CREATE2 custody address from the fixed factory, proxy bytecode hash, singleton, and derivation signer; it also enforces unique derivation signers, owner/module completeness, threshold bounds, address equality, and sorting.

book.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks descending price order, duplicate merging, ladder completeness, and correlation with the raw response and held position.

maxFeeRateBps.$comment: The exact getter result. The PMVS verifier requires a positive value when an unresolved held position selects this route for a displayed-book cross mark.
The exact getter result. The PMVS verifier requires a positive value when an unresolved held position selects this route for a displayed-book cross mark.

negativeRiskConfig.$comment: The PMVS verifier checks question derivations, result nullability, event equality, and the selected upstream adapter's source and state correspondence.

negativeCollateralAdapterRedemption.$comment: The six sweep entries cover the outer adapter's CTF YES/NO, d91's CTF YES/NO and WCOL, and the outer adapter's USDC.e. The PMVS verifier checks account/token/tokenId set completeness.

collateralConfig.$comment: The PMVS verifier recomputes maxUsdceSettlementExposure and requires vaultUsdceBalance and vaultUsdceAllowance to cover it.

wrappedCollateralConfig.$comment: The PMVS verifier recomputes maxRedemptionExposure and requires underlyingBalance to cover it.

response.$comment: Credentials and authorization headers are not fields and are rejected by the closed object. The PMVS verifier checks time ordering, content hashes, and byte-identical retrieval.
